patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive video segments dominate the entire viewport, serving as the primary content display with minimal text overlays.
All textual elements, including navigation and project titles, are rendered in a consistent, small, uppercase sans-serif font, maintaining a subtle informational layer over the dominant visuals.
A high-contrast color scheme is employed, featuring white text against predominantly dark, moody, and often desaturated video backgrounds, with accent colors emerging directly from the video content.

The site's core interaction is a scroll-triggered sequence where each scroll depth reveals a new, distinct full-screen video segment, creating a continuous visual reel. The minimalist navigation remains sticky at the top-left.

Each 'section' of the site is defined by a new full-screen video segment that appears on scroll, effectively presenting individual projects as distinct, immersive cinematic experiences rather than traditional content blocks.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-screen video player that dynamically changes its source or plays through a curated sequence of distinct video clips as the user scrolls down the page. Each video segment is treated as a full-viewport 'section' that snaps into view.

Minimalist, uppercase text labels are positioned centrally over these video sections, providing project titles, and a persistent navigation menu is fixed to the top-left corner, maintaining readability against varying video backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: A very flat type scale, with all text (navigation and project titles) appearing in a small, consistent uppercase size, providing a subtle informational layer over the dominant visuals.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with no visible corner rounding on any elements, contributing to a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Extremely airy, characterized by full-bleed media and minimal, strategically placed text, creating a sense of vastness and focus on the visual content.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its use of a continuous, full-screen, scroll-triggered video reel as the primary content and navigation mechanism. Instead of traditional sections, the user scrolls through a curated sequence of high-production-value video clips, each representing a project, creating an immersive and cinematic portfolio experience.
